family: M&A, business combinations and tender offers

forms.plain_english: Rule 425 filing: any written communication (press release, 8-K-style notice, employee FAQ, investor transcript) about a registered business combination, filed under the SUBJECT company's file number. Often a re-filed 8-K or press release; the form itself has no structured data.
forms.who_files_when: Bidder or target on the day the communication is made, from announcement until the deal closes or dies. Can be 10+ filings in one week (Netflix filed 10 between 2025-12-17 and 2026-01-16).

companies.frequency: event-driven; Netflix/WBD 2025-12 to 2026-01 (Atom page 1 shows 10, more exist)
10+ filings, all Feb-May 2008, Yahoo! bid; newest-first Atom shows no Activision/LinkedIn/Nuance 425 (cash deals)
4 ever, all Apr 2016, debt exchange; no Fitbit/Wiz 425
not checked (budget); no known Apple stock deals

machine_readable.format: HTML (legacy .txt pre-2001); no XBRL. Index page gives machine-readable header: filer CIK AND subject-company CIK
structured_fields: subject company CIK/name (e.g. WBD 0001437107, Yahoo 0001011006, Kraft Foods Group 0001545158)

company.detail: Netflix filed Rule 425 on Warner Bros. Discovery (CIK 1437107). Dec 17 2025: $27.75/WBD share, cash $23.25 + Netflix stock $4.50 with collar, EV about $82.7B, equity $72.0B, plus Discovery Global spin shares.
company.quote: The cash and stock transaction is valued at $27.75 per WBD share.

company.detail: Amazon 425 of 2026-04-14 is actually an 8-K-format cover re Globalstar merger (filer and subject both Amazon). Ex 99.1: $90.00 cash or 0.3210 AMZN shares per Globalstar share, cash elections capped 40%, up to $110M downward adjustment for satellite milestones, close expected 2027, about 58% holders consented.
company.quote: either (i) $90.00 in cash or (ii) 0.3210 shares of Amazon common stock with a value capped at $90.00 per share

company.detail: Microsoft 425s of 2008 relate to the unsolicited Yahoo! bid (subject Yahoo CIK 1011006); Kevin Johnson FAQ memo 2008-02-22 gave no price, expected close 2H 2008. Deal never agreed.
company.quote: we do not have an agreement in place with Yahoo! at this time

company.detail: Berkshire 425 2015-03-25 (subject Kraft Foods Group): Berkshire and 3G put $10B into Heinz, paid out as $16.50 special dividend; 3G+Berkshire 51%, Kraft holders 49%; Berkshire 3 board seats.
company.quote: $16.50 per-share special dividend (paraphrase of transcript; exact quote not captured)

company.detail: Alphabet 425s (Apr 2016) are for a DEBT exchange, not a reorganisation: Google Inc. 3.625% 2021 and 3.375% 2024 notes ($1B each) exchanged into Alphabet notes plus $2.50 cash per $1,000; about 79% tendered by early date.
company.quote: has received the requisite number of consents to adopt certain amendments to the indentures

executives.detail: Netflix 425 of 2026-01-16 reposts NYT interview with co-CEO Ted Sarandos on 45-day theatrical windows; Kevin Johnson (MSFT) authored 2008 Yahoo FAQ; Kraft/Heinz: Bernardo Hees CEO, Alex Behring chairman, Buffett on call.

growth.detail: Amazon-Globalstar ties to Apple: Amazon Leo to power iPhone 14+ and Apple Watch Ultra 3 satellite features; Amazon own D2D system from 2028.
growth.quote: Amazon Leo will power satellite features for supported iPhone and Apple Watch models

signals.detail: Netflix-WBD lifecycle visible in 425/8-K: Dec 2025 stock+cash bid, 2026-01-19 amended to all cash at $27.75, Paramount hostile bid, 2026-02-27 WBD terminated for Paramount Skydance superior proposal; Netflix received $2.8B fee (paid by PSKY on WBD's behalf).
signals.quote: terminated the Merger Agreement in accordance with its terms

signals.detail: Netflix reverse (regulatory) termination fee announced at $5.8B, called largest cash regulatory fee; expected close 12-18 months.
signals.quote: reverse termination fee is $5.8 billion (paraphrase; exact wording not captured)

financial_intelligence.detail: Netflix debt financing: bridge commitment raised from $34.0B to $42.2B on 2026-01-19; commitments auto-terminated Feb 27 2026.
financial_intelligence.quote: The receipt of financing by Netflix is not a condition

forms.suggestion: Deal-state feed: detect 425 filed by A with subject B, then attach terms extracted from the paired 8-K Ex.99/2.1 and flag termination 8-Ks (Netflix-WBD ended 2026-02-27 with a $2.8B fee).
caveats: Atom is newest-first and only first page read: absence of Activision/LinkedIn/Nuance/Whole Foods/MGM/iRobot/Fitbit/Wiz 425s is inferred from no entry in the first page, which for MSFT is 2008 only (page had 10 entries and a next link, so older-than-2008 is irrelevant but 2022 would appear first; it did not).
Amazon 2026 425 exhibits fee amounts not disclosed in the text read.

forms.plain_english: Registration statement for securities issued in a merger or exchange offer. Doubles as proxy statement/prospectus. Contains terms, fees, conditions, fairness opinions, timeline.
forms.who_files_when: Acquirer paying in stock or registered notes, after merger agreement signed; amendments until effective. Cash-only deals file none (hence none for Activision, Whole Foods, MGM, iRobot, Alleghany, PCC, Fitbit, Wiz).

Wesco Financial (S-4 2011-03-07): cash $386.55 per share plus $0.98691/month earnings factor, or Class B stock; Berkshire already owned 5,703,087 shares (80.1%); aggregate fee-table value about $551M.
